provenance: Prior for local Apple-Silicon MLX models served via mlx_lm.server (addressed as opencode:mlx/<model> through the OpenCode adapter, Path A, or mlx:<model> via the dedicated adapter, Path B). Genuine $0 cost — weights run locally on-device, no egress, fully private (distinct from opencode-free-tier's hosted free tier). The FOUR stack dimensions (bug-fix, code-review, long-context, instruction-format) are AUDITION-DERIVED, refreshed 2026-07-26 from the gated live comparison of Qwen2.5-Coder-{7B,14B,32B}-Instruct-4bit on the v1 stack (Path B): bug-fix raw 1.0 across all three models (6/6 items — the family's clear strength, beat the hosted anchor which contract-failed bug-fix); instruction-format raw 1.0 across all three (6/6); code-review mixed (7B 0.43 / 14B 0.77 / 32B 0.68 — the family's relative weak spot vs a hosted reviewer); long-context high-variance and latency-bound on 32 GB (7B 0.5 / 14B 1.0; 32B skipped to avoid KV-cache swap). Priors are held BELOW the observed raw means on purpose — they are k=3 pseudo-observations the roster shrinks n=2–3 audition evidence toward (posterior=(n·raw+3·prior)/(n+3)); setting a prior equal to a raw 1.0 would defeat that humility on a small stack. The tool-use pair command-exec + monitoring are ALSO audition-derived, added 2026-07-26 (issue #235): the propose-and-score tool-use tier (3 command-exec + 3 monitoring items, deterministic command-check scorer, no live shell) scored raw 1.0 for ALL THREE model scales on BOTH dims (18/18 perfect) — the strongest, lowest-variance signal in the whole stack and tied with Haiku 4.5 and the hosted agy anchor, which also scored raw 1.0. Held at 0.72 per the same humility convention as bug-fix/instruction-format (their raw was also 1.0). Honest caveat: this foundational tier does not discriminate at the top end — it certifies that local models clear the bar for basic command production and stop-condition judgment; the real differentiator is latency (7B ~0s < 14B ~2s < 32B ~5s) and $0 cost, where the smallest local model wins. A harder tool-use tier is the follow-up. The legacy rollup key `tool-use` is bumped to 0.72 to match. The remaining FOUR unexercised dimensions (code-gen, refactor, reasoning, research) remain conservative pre-audit placeholders. See retrospectives/232-external-agent-delegation.md and retrospectives/235-council-tool-use-assessment.md.
